title: IndiaElectricityBill
description: Normalized schema for any domestic/commercial electricity bill issued by any Indian DISCOM. The file_processor LLM maps whatever layout it sees onto these canonical fields; unknown fields stay null (no fabrication). Monetary values are INR; consumption is kWh (units).

discom.description: Issuing distribution company, e.g. TGSPDCL, APSPDCL, BESCOM, MSEDCL, TANGEDCO, BSES Rajdhani, Tata Power-DDL, UPPCL, PSPCL, WBSEDCL, CESC, Adani Electricity, JVVNL, DGVCL.

state.description: State / UT the connection is in.

service_number.description: The unique connection identifier as printed. Map from whatever the bill calls it: Service No., CA No., USC/Unique Service Connection No., K.No., IVRS No., Account ID, Consumer No., RR No., BU/SC No.

account_id.description: A second identifier if the bill prints both a service number and a separate account/ledger id.

connection_type.description: Low / High / Extra-High Tension if stated.

sanctioned_load_kw.description: Sanctioned/contracted load in kW (convert HP→kW ×0.746 if only HP is given).

billing_month.description: Billing month as printed, e.g. 'Oct 2026' or '10/2026'.

billed_demand_kw.description: Recorded/billed maximum demand in kW/kVA (HT & commercial).

charges.description: Slab-wise / component-wise energy charge lines exactly as printed, top to bottom.

rate.description: Rate per unit in INR/kWh for this slab.

energy_charges.description: Total energy/consumption charge (sum of slab amounts).

customer_charges.description: Customer / meter rent / fixed monthly service charge.

subsidy.description: Any subsidy/rebate applied (e.g. state free-units subsidy). Negative if it reduces the bill, as printed.

adjustments.description: Any credit/debit adjustment, rounding, or 'adjustment' line.

other_charges.description: Any remaining printed line items not covered above.

total_amount.description: Net amount payable by the due date (current bill total incl. duty, fixed, FCA, less subsidy).

amount_after_due_date.description: Amount payable with late-payment surcharge, if printed.

source_language.description: Primary script/language the bill was printed in, e.g. 'en', 'te', 'ta', 'hi', 'kn', 'bn', 'mr', 'gu'.

extraction_confidence.description: Model's self-estimated confidence 0-1 that the key figures (units, total) are correct. Used to route low-confidence bills to human review.
